/*
    Dashboard Tổng quan — DASH_Overview_GetData
    Nguồn: SIM_Student, SIM_Class, SIM_Science, SIM_Course, SIM_Teacher, ACC_Receipt, LIB_*

    @YearID, @Semester — tuỳ chọn (ảnh hưởng tuyển sinh, giảng dạy, học phí)
    @ScienceID, @CourseID — tuỳ chọn
    @ResultSet: 1..12 trả 1 result set; NULL trả đủ 12 result set

    Result set  1 — KPI tổng hợp
    Result set  2 — Sinh viên theo khoa (donut)
    Result set  3 — Tuyển sinh / nhập học theo tháng
    Result set  4 — Tỷ lệ tốt nghiệp theo năm
    Result set  5 — Kết quả học tập theo khoa (stacked)
    Result set  6 — Doanh thu học phí theo tháng
    Result set  7 — Tỷ lệ thu học phí (radial)
    Result set  8 — Khối lượng giảng dạy theo khoa
    Result set  9 — Giờ giảng theo tháng
    Result set 10 — Thư viện theo tháng
    Result set 11 — Top 10 sách mượn nhiều
    Result set 12 — Cảnh báo
*/

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.DASH_Overview_GetData', N'P') IS NOT NULL
    DROP PROCEDURE dbo.DASH_Overview_GetData;
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.DASH_Overview_GetData
(
    @YearID int = NULL,
    @Semester tinyint = NULL,
    @ScienceID nvarchar(50) = NULL,
    @CourseID nvarchar(50) = NULL,
    @ResultSet tinyint = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    Declare @CalendarYear int;
    Set @CalendarYear = Year(GetDate());

    Select
        SIM_Class.ClassID,
        SIM_Class.ClassName,
        SIM_Class.ScienceID,
        SIM_Science.ScienceName,
        SIM_Class.CourseID,
        SIM_Course.CourseName,
        ISNULL(tblStudent.TotalStudent, 0) as NowStudentCount,
        ISNULL(tblStudent.StudyQuantity, 0) as StudyQuantity,
        ISNULL(tblStudent.GraduationQuantity, 0) as GraduationQuantity,
        ISNULL(tblStudent.WarningQuantity, 0) as WarningQuantity,
        ISNULL(tblStudent.DebtStudentCount, 0) as DebtStudentCount,
        ISNULL(tblStudent.TotalDebtMoney, 0) as TotalDebtMoney
    Into #tblClassData
    From SIM_Class
        Inner Join SIM_Course On SIM_Course.CourseID = SIM_Class.CourseID
        Inner Join SIM_Science On SIM_Science.ScienceID = SIM_Class.ScienceID
        Left Join
        (
            Select
                SIM_Student.ClassID,
                Count(*) as TotalStudent,
                Sum(Case when SIM_Student.Status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as StudyQuantity,
                Sum(Case when SIM_Student.Status = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as GraduationQuantity,
                Sum(Case when SIM_Student.Status not in (1, 2) then 1 else 0 end) as WarningQuantity,
                Sum(Case when SIM_Student.Status = 1 And ISNULL(SIM_Student.DebtMoney, 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as DebtStudentCount,
                Sum(Case when SIM_Student.Status = 1 then ISNULL(SIM_Student.DebtMoney, 0) else 0 end) as TotalDebtMoney
            From SIM_Student
            Where SIM_Student.IsDeleted = 0
            Group by SIM_Student.ClassID
        ) tblStudent on tblStudent.ClassID = SIM_Class.ClassID
    Where SIM_Class.IsActived = 1
        And SIM_Class.ClassType = 0
        And (@ScienceID is null or @ScienceID = N'' or SIM_Class.ScienceID = @ScienceID)
        And (@CourseID is null or @CourseID = N'' or SIM_Class.CourseID = @CourseID);

    /* Result set 1 — KPI */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 1
    BEGIN
        Declare @TotalStudent int;
        Declare @StudyingStudent int;
        Declare @GraduatedStudent int;
        Declare @WarningStudent int;
        Declare @TotalClass int;
        Declare @TotalTeacher int;
        Declare @TotalDebtMoney decimal(18, 0);
        Declare @DebtStudentCount int;
        Declare @FeeRate decimal(18, 1);
        Declare @GraduationRate decimal(18, 1);
        Declare @TotalBooks int;

        Select
            @TotalClass = COUNT(*),
            @TotalStudent = ISNULL(SUM(NowStudentCount), 0),
            @StudyingStudent = ISNULL(SUM(StudyQuantity), 0),
            @GraduatedStudent = ISNULL(SUM(GraduationQuantity), 0),
            @WarningStudent = ISNULL(SUM(WarningQuantity), 0),
            @DebtStudentCount = ISNULL(SUM(DebtStudentCount), 0),
            @TotalDebtMoney = ISNULL(SUM(TotalDebtMoney), 0)
        From #tblClassData;

        Select @TotalTeacher = COUNT(*)
        From SIM_Teacher
        Where SIM_Teacher.IsActived = 1;

        If @StudyingStudent > 0
            Set @FeeRate = Round(((@StudyingStudent - @DebtStudentCount) * 100.0) / @StudyingStudent, 1);
        Else
            Set @FeeRate = 0;

        If (@StudyingStudent + @GraduatedStudent) > 0
            Set @GraduationRate = Round((@GraduatedStudent * 100.0) / (@StudyingStudent + @GraduatedStudent), 1);
        Else
            Set @GraduationRate = 0;

        Set @TotalBooks = 0;
        If OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.LIB_Book', N'U') IS NOT NULL
        Begin
            Select @TotalBooks = COUNT(*)
            From LIB_Book
            Where ISNULL(LIB_Book.IsDeleted, 0) = 0;
        End

        Select
            @TotalStudent as TotalStudent,
            @StudyingStudent as StudyingStudent,
            @TotalTeacher as TotalTeacher,
            @TotalClass as TotalClass,
            @GraduationRate as GraduationRate,
            @WarningStudent as WarningStudent,
            @TotalDebtMoney as TotalDebtMoney,
            @DebtStudentCount as DebtStudentCount,
            @FeeRate as FeeRate,
            @TotalBooks as TotalBooks;
    END

    /* Result set 2 — Sinh viên theo khoa */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 2
    BEGIN
        Select
            ScienceID,
            ScienceName,
            ISNULL(SUM(NowStudentCount), 0) as StudentCount
        From #tblClassData
        Group by ScienceID, ScienceName
        Having ISNULL(SUM(NowStudentCount), 0) > 0
        Order by ScienceName;
    END

    /* Result set 3 — Tuyển sinh / nhập học theo tháng (năm dương lịch hiện tại) */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 3
    BEGIN
        ;With tblMonth as
        (
            Select 1 as MonthNo Union All Select 2 Union All Select 3 Union All Select 4 Union All
            Select 5 Union All Select 6 Union All Select 7 Union All Select 8 Union All
            Select 9 Union All Select 10 Union All Select 11 Union All Select 12
        )
        Select
            tblMonth.MonthNo,
            N'T' + Cast(tblMonth.MonthNo as nvarchar(2)) as MonthLabel,
            ISNULL(tblRegister.RegisterCount, 0) as RegisterCount,
            ISNULL(tblEnroll.EnrollCount, 0) as EnrollCount
        From tblMonth
            Left Join
            (
                Select
                    Month(SIM_Student.CreatedDate) as MonthNo,
                    Count(*) as RegisterCount
                From SIM_Student
                    Inner Join #tblClassData On #tblClassData.ClassID = SIM_Student.ClassID
                Where SIM_Student.IsDeleted = 0
                    And SIM_Student.CreatedDate is not null
                    And Year(SIM_Student.CreatedDate) = @CalendarYear
                Group by Month(SIM_Student.CreatedDate)
            ) tblRegister on tblRegister.MonthNo = tblMonth.MonthNo
            Left Join
            (
                Select
                    Month(ISNULL(SIM_Student.RealLearningDate, SIM_Student.ReceivedDate)) as MonthNo,
                    Count(*) as EnrollCount
                From SIM_Student
                    Inner Join #tblClassData On #tblClassData.ClassID = SIM_Student.ClassID
                Where SIM_Student.IsDeleted = 0
                    And SIM_Student.Status in (1, 2)
                    And ISNULL(SIM_Student.RealLearningDate, SIM_Student.ReceivedDate) is not null
                    And Year(ISNULL(SIM_Student.RealLearningDate, SIM_Student.ReceivedDate)) = @CalendarYear
                Group by Month(ISNULL(SIM_Student.RealLearningDate, SIM_Student.ReceivedDate))
            ) tblEnroll on tblEnroll.MonthNo = tblMonth.MonthNo
        Order by tblMonth.MonthNo;
    END

    /* Result set 4 — Tỷ lệ tốt nghiệp theo năm */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 4
    BEGIN
        Select
            Cast(ISNULL(SIM_Student.GraduationYear, Year(SIM_Student.UpdatedDate)) as nvarchar(4)) as GraduationYear,
            Count(*) as GraduatedCount
        From SIM_Student
            Inner Join #tblClassData On #tblClassData.ClassID = SIM_Student.ClassID
        Where SIM_Student.IsDeleted = 0
            And SIM_Student.Status = 2
        Group by ISNULL(SIM_Student.GraduationYear, Year(SIM_Student.UpdatedDate))
        Order by GraduationYear;
    END

    /* Result set 5 — Kết quả học tập theo khoa */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 5
    BEGIN
        Select
            #tblClassData.ScienceID,
            #tblClassData.ScienceName,
            Sum(Case
                when SIM_Student.LearningLevel like N'%Giỏi%' or SIM_Student.LearningLevel like N'%Gioi%' then 1
                else 0
            end) as ExcellentCount,
            Sum(Case
                when SIM_Student.LearningLevel like N'%Khá%' or SIM_Student.LearningLevel like N'%Kha%' then 1
                else 0
            end) as GoodCount,
            Sum(Case
                when SIM_Student.LearningLevel like N'%Trung bình%' or SIM_Student.LearningLevel like N'%Trung binh%' or SIM_Student.LearningLevel like N'%TB%' then 1
                else 0
            end) as AverageCount,
            Sum(Case
                when SIM_Student.LearningLevel like N'%Yếu%' or SIM_Student.LearningLevel like N'%Yêu%' or SIM_Student.LearningLevel like N'%Kém%' or SIM_Student.LearningLevel like N'%Kem%' then 1
                else 0
            end) as WeakCount
        From SIM_Student
            Inner Join #tblClassData On #tblClassData.ClassID = SIM_Student.ClassID
        Where SIM_Student.IsDeleted = 0
            And SIM_Student.Status = 1
        Group by #tblClassData.ScienceID, #tblClassData.ScienceName
        Order by #tblClassData.ScienceName;
    END

    /* Result set 6 — Doanh thu học phí theo tháng */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 6
    BEGIN
        If OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ACC_Receipt', N'U') IS NOT NULL
        Begin
            ;With tblMonth as
            (
                Select 1 as MonthNo Union All Select 2 Union All Select 3 Union All Select 4 Union All
                Select 5 Union All Select 6 Union All Select 7 Union All Select 8 Union All
                Select 9 Union All Select 10 Union All Select 11 Union All Select 12
            )
            Select
                tblMonth.MonthNo,
                N'T' + Cast(tblMonth.MonthNo as nvarchar(2)) as MonthLabel,
                ISNULL(Round(tblCollected.CollectedAmount / 1000000.0, 0), 0) as CollectedAmount,
                ISNULL(Round(tblDebt.DebtAmount / 1000000.0, 0), 0) as DebtAmount
            From tblMonth
                Left Join
                (
                    Select
                        Month(ACC_Receipt.ReceiptDate) as MonthNo,
                        Sum(ISNULL(ACC_Receipt.TotalMoney, 0)) as CollectedAmount
                    From ACC_Receipt
                    Where ACC_Receipt.ReceiptDate is not null
                        And Year(ACC_Receipt.ReceiptDate) = @CalendarYear
                        And ISNULL(ACC_Receipt.IsDeleted, 0) = 0
                    Group by Month(ACC_Receipt.ReceiptDate)
                ) tblCollected on tblCollected.MonthNo = tblMonth.MonthNo
                Left Join
                (
                    Select
                        Month(SIM_Student.NextReceiptPlanDate) as MonthNo,
                        Sum(ISNULL(SIM_Student.NextReceiptPlanMoney, 0)) as DebtAmount
                    From SIM_Student
                        Inner Join #tblClassData On #tblClassData.ClassID = SIM_Student.ClassID
                    Where SIM_Student.IsDeleted = 0
                        And SIM_Student.Status = 1
                        And SIM_Student.NextReceiptPlanDate is not null
                        And Year(SIM_Student.NextReceiptPlanDate) = @CalendarYear
                    Group by Month(SIM_Student.NextReceiptPlanDate)
                ) tblDebt on tblDebt.MonthNo = tblMonth.MonthNo
            Order by tblMonth.MonthNo;
        End
        Else
        Begin
            Select
                Cast(null as int) as MonthNo,
                Cast(null as nvarchar(7)) as MonthLabel,
                Cast(0 as decimal(18, 0)) as CollectedAmount,
                Cast(0 as decimal(18, 0)) as DebtAmount
            Where 1 = 0;
        End
    END

    /* Result set 7 — Tỷ lệ thu học phí */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 7
    BEGIN
        Declare @StudyingCount int;
        Declare @PaidCount int;
        Declare @Rate decimal(18, 1);

        Select @StudyingCount = ISNULL(SUM(StudyQuantity), 0)
        From #tblClassData;

        Select @PaidCount = Count(*)
        From SIM_Student
            Inner Join #tblClassData On #tblClassData.ClassID = SIM_Student.ClassID
        Where SIM_Student.IsDeleted = 0
            And SIM_Student.Status = 1
            And ISNULL(SIM_Student.DebtMoney, 0) <= 0;

        If @StudyingCount > 0
            Set @Rate = Round((@PaidCount * 100.0) / @StudyingCount, 1);
        Else
            Set @Rate = 0;

        Select @Rate as FeeRate;
    END

    /* Result set 8 — Khối lượng giảng dạy theo khoa */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 8
    BEGIN
        If OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.SIM_Class_Subject', N'U') IS NOT NULL
        Begin
            Select Top 10
                SIM_Science.ScienceName,
                ISNULL(Sum(ISNULL(SIM_Class_Subject.UnitText, 0)), 0) as TeachingUnit
            From SIM_Class_Subject
                Inner Join SIM_Class On SIM_Class.ClassID = SIM_Class_Subject.ClassID
                Inner Join SIM_Science On SIM_Science.ScienceID = SIM_Class.ScienceID
                Inner Join #tblClassData On #tblClassData.ClassID = SIM_Class.ClassID
            Where SIM_Class.IsActived = 1
                And (@YearID is null or SIM_Class_Subject.YearID = @YearID)
                And (@Semester is null or SIM_Class_Subject.Semester = @Semester)
            Group by SIM_Science.ScienceName
            Order by TeachingUnit Desc;
        End
        Else
        Begin
            Select
                Cast(null as nvarchar(200)) as ScienceName,
                Cast(0 as decimal(18, 0)) as TeachingUnit
            Where 1 = 0;
        End
    END

    /* Result set 9 — Giờ giảng theo tháng */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 9
    BEGIN
        If OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.SIM_Schedule', N'U') IS NOT NULL
        Begin
            ;With tblMonth as
            (
                Select 1 as MonthNo Union All Select 2 Union All Select 3 Union All Select 4 Union All
                Select 5 Union All Select 6 Union All Select 7 Union All Select 8 Union All
                Select 9 Union All Select 10 Union All Select 11 Union All Select 12
            )
            Select
                tblMonth.MonthNo,
                N'T' + Cast(tblMonth.MonthNo as nvarchar(2)) as MonthLabel,
                ISNULL(tblHours.TeachingHours, 0) as TeachingHours
            From tblMonth
                Left Join
                (
                    Select
                        Month(SIM_Schedule.Date) as MonthNo,
                        Count(*) as TeachingHours
                    From SIM_Schedule
                        Inner Join SIM_Class On SIM_Class.ClassID = SIM_Schedule.ClassID
                        Inner Join #tblClassData On #tblClassData.ClassID = SIM_Class.ClassID
                    Where SIM_Schedule.Date is not null
                        And Year(SIM_Schedule.Date) = @CalendarYear
                        And (@YearID is null or SIM_Schedule.YearID = @YearID)
                        And (@Semester is null or SIM_Schedule.Semester = @Semester)
                    Group by Month(SIM_Schedule.Date)
                ) tblHours on tblHours.MonthNo = tblMonth.MonthNo
            Order by tblMonth.MonthNo;
        End
        Else
        Begin
            Select
                Cast(null as int) as MonthNo,
                Cast(null as nvarchar(7)) as MonthLabel,
                Cast(0 as int) as TeachingHours
            Where 1 = 0;
        End
    END

    /* Result set 10 — Thư viện theo tháng */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 10
    BEGIN
        If OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.LIB_Lend', N'U') IS NOT NULL
        Begin
            ;With tblMonth as
            (
                Select 1 as MonthNo Union All Select 2 Union All Select 3 Union All Select 4 Union All
                Select 5 Union All Select 6 Union All Select 7 Union All Select 8 Union All
                Select 9 Union All Select 10 Union All Select 11 Union All Select 12
            )
            Select
                tblMonth.MonthNo,
                N'T' + Cast(tblMonth.MonthNo as nvarchar(2)) as MonthLabel,
                ISNULL(tblBorrow.BorrowCount, 0) as BorrowCount,
                ISNULL(tblReturn.ReturnCount, 0) as ReturnCount
            From tblMonth
                Left Join
                (
                    Select
                        Month(LIB_Lend.LendDate) as MonthNo,
                        Count(*) as BorrowCount
                    From LIB_Lend
                    Where LIB_Lend.LendDate is not null
                        And Year(LIB_Lend.LendDate) = @CalendarYear
                    Group by Month(LIB_Lend.LendDate)
                ) tblBorrow on tblBorrow.MonthNo = tblMonth.MonthNo
                Left Join
                (
                    Select
                        Month(LIB_Lend.ReturnDate) as MonthNo,
                        Count(*) as ReturnCount
                    From LIB_Lend
                    Where LIB_Lend.ReturnDate is not null
                        And Year(LIB_Lend.ReturnDate) = @CalendarYear
                    Group by Month(LIB_Lend.ReturnDate)
                ) tblReturn on tblReturn.MonthNo = tblMonth.MonthNo
            Order by tblMonth.MonthNo;
        End
        Else
        Begin
            Select
                Cast(null as int) as MonthNo,
                Cast(null as nvarchar(7)) as MonthLabel,
                Cast(0 as int) as BorrowCount,
                Cast(0 as int) as ReturnCount
            Where 1 = 0;
        End
    END

    /* Result set 11 — Top 10 sách mượn nhiều */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 11
    BEGIN
        If OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.LIB_Lend', N'U') IS NOT NULL And OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.LIB_Book', N'U') IS NOT NULL
        Begin
            Select Top 10
                LIB_Book.BookName,
                Count(*) as BorrowCount
            From LIB_Lend
                Inner Join LIB_Book On LIB_Book.BookID = LIB_Lend.BookID
            Where LIB_Lend.LendDate is not null
            Group by LIB_Book.BookName
            Order by BorrowCount Desc;
        End
        Else
        Begin
            Select
                Cast(null as nvarchar(500)) as BookName,
                Cast(0 as int) as BorrowCount
            Where 1 = 0;
        End
    END

    /* Result set 12 — Cảnh báo */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 12
    BEGIN
        Select
            N'danger' as AlertType,
            N'warning-study' as AlertCode,
            Cast(ISNULL(SUM(WarningQuantity), 0) as nvarchar(20)) + N' sinh viên cảnh báo / nghỉ học (trạng thái không đang học hoặc tốt nghiệp)' as AlertText,
            N'Trạng thái SV · Cập nhật từ hệ thống' as AlertMeta
        From #tblClassData
        Where ISNULL(SUM(WarningQuantity), 0) > 0

        Union All

        Select
            N'danger',
            N'warning-debt',
            Cast(ISNULL(SUM(DebtStudentCount), 0) as nvarchar(20)) + N' sinh viên còn công nợ học phí',
            N'Tổng nợ: ' + Format(ISNULL(SUM(TotalDebtMoney), 0), N'N0') + N' đ'
        From #tblClassData
        Where ISNULL(SUM(DebtStudentCount), 0) > 0

        Union All

        Select
            N'warning',
            N'warning-failed',
            Cast(Count(*) as nvarchar(20)) + N' sinh viên nợ nhiều môn hoặc điểm TB thấp',
            N'Điểm TB < 5 hoặc nợ > 3 môn'
        From SIM_Student
            Inner Join #tblClassData On #tblClassData.ClassID = SIM_Student.ClassID
        Where SIM_Student.IsDeleted = 0
            And SIM_Student.Status = 1
            And (ISNULL(SIM_Student.LearningSummary, 10) < 5 Or ISNULL(SIM_Student.FailedSubjectCount, 0) > 3)
            And Count(*) > 0;
    END
END
GO

/*
    Ví dụ test:
    Exec dbo.DASH_Overview_GetData @ResultSet = 1;
    Exec dbo.DASH_Overview_GetData @ScienceID = NULL, @CourseID = NULL;
*/

    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 12
    BEGIN
        Declare @AlertWarningQty int;
        Declare @AlertDebtQty int;
        Declare @AlertDebtAmt decimal(18, 0);
        Declare @AlertFailedQty int;

        Select
            @AlertWarningQty = ISNULL(SUM(WarningQuantity), 0),
            @AlertDebtQty = ISNULL(SUM(DebtStudentCount), 0),
            @AlertDebtAmt = ISNULL(SUM(TotalDebtMoney), 0)
        From #tblClassData;

        Select @AlertFailedQty = Count(*)
        From SIM_Student
            Inner Join #tblClassData On #tblClassData.ClassID = SIM_Student.ClassID
        Where SIM_Student.IsDeleted = 0
            And SIM_Student.Status = 1
            And (ISNULL(SIM_Student.LearningSummary, 10) < 5 Or ISNULL(SIM_Student.FailedSubjectCount, 0) > 3);

        Select
            AlertType,
            AlertCode,
            AlertText,
            AlertMeta
        From
        (
            Select
                N'danger' as AlertType,
                N'warning-study' as AlertCode,
                Cast(@AlertWarningQty as nvarchar(20)) + N' sinh viên cảnh báo / nghỉ học (trạng thái không đang học hoặc tốt nghiệp)' as AlertText,
                N'Trạng thái SV · Cập nhật từ hệ thống' as AlertMeta
            Where @AlertWarningQty > 0

            Union All

            Select
                N'danger',
                N'warning-debt',
                Cast(@AlertDebtQty as nvarchar(20)) + N' sinh viên còn công nợ học phí',
                N'Tổng nợ: ' + Format(@AlertDebtAmt, N'N0') + N' đ'
            Where @AlertDebtQty > 0

            Union All

            Select
                N'warning',
                N'warning-failed',
                Cast(@AlertFailedQty as nvarchar(20)) + N' sinh viên nợ nhiều môn hoặc điểm TB thấp',
                N'Điểm TB < 5 hoặc nợ > 3 môn'
            Where @AlertFailedQty > 0
        ) tblAlert;
    END

content.text:
Đã chuyển dashboard **Tổng quan** (`/bang-dieu-khien.html`) từ dữ liệu mock sang dữ liệu thật, **giữ nguyên layout và kiểu chart ApexCharts**.

## Luồng dữ liệu mới

```
SIM_* / ACC_* / LIB_* 
  → DASH_Overview_GetData (SP)
  → HomeDashboardApi.ashx (JSON)
  → school-dashboard.init.js (ApexCharts)
```

## File đã tạo / sửa

| Thành phần | File |
|---|---|
| SP filter | `sql/DASH_Overview_GetFilter.sql` |
| SP data (12 result set) | `sql/DASH_Overview_GetData.sql` |
| API | `hos/Dashboards/API/HomeDashboardApi.ashx` (+ `.cs`) |
| UI | `hos/Dashboards/RightPageMainDashboard.ascx` |
| JS | `hos/assetsDashboard/js/pages/school-dashboard.init.js` |
| CSS loading | `hos/assetsDashboard/css/school-dashboard.css` |

## Dữ liệu thật đã nối

- **8 KPI**: sinh viên, giáo viên, lớp, tỷ lệ TN, cảnh báo, công nợ, thu học phí, đầu sách
- **Chart**: SV theo khoa (donut), tuyển sinh/nhập học, TN theo năm, xếp loại học tập, doanh thu HP, tỷ lệ thu HP, khối lượng GD, giờ giảng, thư viện, top sách
- **Cảnh báo + Insight**: sinh từ dữ liệu thật (nợ HP, SV cảnh báo, điểm TB thấp…)
- **Bộ lọc**: Năm học / Học kỳ / Khoa / Khóa — load động từ DB

## Việc cần làm trên SQL Server

Chạy 2 script (theo thứ tự, sau khi đã có `DASH_StudentClassSize_GetFilter`):

```sql
-- 1. Filter
sql/DASH_Overview_GetFilter.sql

-- 2. Data
sql/DASH_Overview_GetData.sql
```

Sau đó build lại project web và mở `/bang-dieu-khien.html` (đã đăng nhập + có quyền `frmWebStudentList_View`).

## Ghi chú

- Chart **doanh thu / thư viện / giờ giảng** chỉ có dữ liệu nếu DB có bảng `ACC_Receipt`, `LIB_Lend`, `LIB_Book`, `SIM_Schedule` — SP đã bọc `IF OBJECT_ID` nên không lỗi nếu thiếu bảng, chart sẽ rỗng.
- KPI **trend %** (so với kỳ trước) chưa có dữ liệu lịch sử — hiện hiển thị mô tả thực tế thay vì số giả.
- Nếu tên cột bảng thư viện/kế toán khác schema thực tế, báo lại để chỉnh SP cho khớp.

Bạn muốn tôi tiếp tục phase 2 (nối thêm trend so kỳ trước, hoặc chart tốt nghiệp theo `ThongKeTotNghiep_Web`) không?
